summary: This is an 8-K filing by Benchmark 2026-B43 Mortgage Trust, a commercial mortgage-backed securities issuing entity, reporting the closing of a securitization transaction on May 20, 2026. The depositor caused the issuance of multiple classes of pass-through certificates under a pooling and servicing agreement dated December 1, 2025. Underwriters purchased the offered certificates. There is no special situation; this is a routine asset-backed securities issuance filing with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is a standard reporting requirement for a securitization closing.
